window.loadMuseumTexture = function(){ // 1. Wait until the page loads and check if our shortcode generated the image URL document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function() { if (window.museumImageURL) { console.log("Found museum image URL:", window.museumImageURL); // 2. Initialize the Three.js Texture Loader const textureLoader = new THREE.TextureLoader(); // 3. Load the image URL dynamically passed from WordPress textureLoader.load(window.museumImageURL, function(texture) { // Adjust texture settings to prevent stretching texture.wrapS = THREE.RepeatWrapping; texture.wrapT = THREE.RepeatWrapping; // 4. Create your material using the loaded texture const artMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ map: texture, side: THREE.DoubleSide }); // 5. Apply the material to your 3D mesh inside your scene // (Replace 'yourArtworkMesh' with the actual variable name of your 3D canvas or wall mesh) if (typeof pPlane2 !== 'undefined') { pPlane2.material = artMaterial; pPlane2.material.needsUpdate = true; } console.log("Three.js gallery texture successfully applied!"); }); } else { console.warn("No museum image URL found. Using default Three.js materials."); } });
